items.title: Building an Enterprise RAG System with SharePoint Online and Amazon Quick
items.summary: It’s a common challenge for customers: years of dynamic institutional knowledge – company policies, organization structures, employee handbooks – sit buried across thousands of documents, and employees waste hours hunting for answers that already exist. In this blog post, we share how Amazon Quick (Quick) turns SharePoint Online content into a secure, conversational RAG knowledge […]
